name: flask
description: Flask application conventions for maintainable local web products.
guidelines: Prefer an application factory or clearly separated modules once the product is more than a tiny demo.
Keep routes, persistence, background tasks and Socket.IO integration separated enough to test independently.
Expose a lightweight /health endpoint that does not hide dependency failures relevant to startup.
Use environment variables for service URLs and secrets; never bake secrets into source or Compose files.
definition_of_done: Application starts predictably under the configured WSGI/dev runtime.
Routes fail with user-appropriate errors rather than raw stack traces.
